result.markdown: --- title: "A placeholder while the site is being built" description: "One chart from Kitchener's phone-queue data, standing in until the first real posts are written." date: "2026-09-11" categories: [Snapshot, City Services, Kitchener] image: images/thumbnail.png draft: false --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} **This is a temporary placeholder.** Charting Waterloo Region is still being built. This post holds one chart so the site has something to show, and it will be replaced by real posts shortly. It is not an example of what the [About](../../about.qmd) page describes: there is no analysis here, and no data download. ::: Between 2019 and 2023, the share of weekday calls the City of Kitchener answered within 30 seconds fell from 80% to 69%. The City's own target is 80%. ## Data and methods The chart uses daily phone-queue metrics published by the City of Kitchener, covering 1 March 2019 to 30 July 2023. Weekends and statutory holidays are left out, because the contact centre runs a skeleton service on those days. A call that was abandoned while waiting counts as a miss against the 30-second target. The full sources and licences are in this post's `README.md`. A fuller treatment of the same data is written up in the `kitchener-phone-wait-times` post, which is not published yet. ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Reproducibility **Reproduce the post**: get the code and data for this post from [`posts/placeholder/`](https://github.com/gpberber/chartingwaterlooregion/tree/master/posts/placeholder) on GitHub.
